material_findings.finding: The initial implementation took its index snapshot after check_freeze had read Git and did not measure source-freeze reads. The revised public entrypoints now snapshot before Git, force GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 and retain final index hashes/absence on ordinary refusal paths. Frozen predecessor modules remain unchanged.
material_findings.validation: Independent static inspection of the revised wrappers; no extra qualification run.

material_findings.finding: The initial implementation promoted the first task gate before the final check_freeze and could retain a promoted result when that check raised. The revised implementation checks source before promotion and catches ordinary qualification errors into UNKNOWN_ADMISSION with first_task_gate UNKNOWN. The outer index comparison also demotes on changes.
material_findings.validation: Independent static inspection of final source-check ordering and both refusal paths.

material_findings.finding: Qualification freeze rechecks working bytes under research/unified_consequence_runtime and .github/workflows. The all-repository baseline-preservation check compares committed trees. A postfreeze working-byte change to an existing tracked file outside those subtrees is not detected by check_freeze itself.
material_findings.implication: Do not derive an all-repository working-byte-preservation claim from this qualifier alone. The separately authorized complete baseline inventory audit can support that broader claim. No such change was observed in this review.

material_findings.finding: The local 39-control retention contains contracts.log and native-evidence, but no qualification RESULT.json, source/runtime freeze or standalone private attempt/index-before ledger. It supports the observed acceptance controls and retained replay, not a complete qualification or total launch/index-preservation claim.
material_findings.implication: Require the separately retained qualification freeze/result/index sidecar and complete accounting for any ADMISSION_ONLY_QUALIFIED statement.

metadata_native_separation.finding: V4 reuses exact V3 derivation/selection bytecode in private globals and changes only its ast.parse binding: setup.py parses normally; all other Python source yields an empty metadata AST. Every raw tracked file still contributes to the original complete path-to-SHA256 inventory. Non-Python supported metadata and catalog licensing semantics remain unchanged.
